title: SCHC adaptation vector fixture fields are parsed but never asserted
description: rust/lichen-schc/tests/adaptation_vectors.rs includes five raw-fragment transition-oracle fields in AdaptationVector for every feature set, but reads them only when raw-fragment-codec+test-utils compiles the production-path duplicate transition. Clippy -D warnings fails reduced feature gates. Compile those fields under the same feature condition; in the full feature gate they remain consumed and asserted by the duplicate transition test.
